paper: AlphaAgents: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents for Equity Portfolio Constructions
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored repeatable monthly U.S.-stock implementation of AlphaAgents' risk-neutral three-specialist round-robin debate; not a replay or backcast of the paper's February 2024 ticker list and not a native GPT-4o/AutoGen replication.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Fundamental, sentiment, and valuation specialists analyze role-specific inputs and debate divergent conclusions before issuing a consolidated stock recommendation.
The fundamental role uses filings and financial statements, the sentiment role uses news and analyst changes, and the valuation role uses price, volume, return, and volatility tools.
AutoGen coordinates agents in round-robin debate, gives every specialist at least two speaking opportunities, exposes peer analyses, and asks the group assistant to consolidate a BUY/SELL consensus.
Risk tolerance is embedded in agent instructions; the direct multi-agent headline uses a risk-neutral profile and turns consensus inclusions into an equal-weight stock portfolio.

debate_policy.agent_initial_opinion: equal mean of signed monthly cross-sectional characteristic ranks
debate_policy.agent_debate_update: when speaking, retain 0.65 of the current specialist opinion and add 0.35 of the current median peer opinion
debate_policy.group_assistant_consensus: median of the three post-debate opinions; sign is BUY or SELL and absolute value is confidence
debate_policy.score_refresh: monthly from contemporaneously available characteristics only; no realized return trains or updates the debate
debate_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: frozen value-weighted long-short deciles; this replaces the paper's one-off equal-weight BUY portfolio for apples-to-apples evaluation

preserved_elements: role-specific data access rather than one undifferentiated score
at least two speaking opportunities for every specialist
peer analyses updating each specialist's view
group-assistant median consolidation into BUY/SELL direction and confidence
the paper's direct risk-neutral multi-agent headline profile
approximated_elements: JKP accounting-quality characteristics replace filing retrieval and financial-statement RAG
earnings and sales surprises plus attention proxies replace Bloomberg news and analyst text
monthly momentum, price-location, turnover, and volatility characteristics replace Yahoo price/volume tool calls
numeric opinion updates replace GPT-4o reasoning and AutoGen messages
two deterministic debate passes replace natural-language convergence and human review
the common decile portfolio replaces one-time equal-weight consensus inclusions
invented_elements: the exact signed characteristic membership of each specialist
median confidence as the consolidated continuous score
the long-short interpretation of SELL opinions in the common adapter
